column2: Why is a one-sample proportion interval not appropriate when comparing two groups?

column2: Which design can justify a two-sample z-interval for a difference in proportions?

column2: When sampling without replacement, what additional check is needed?

column2: What does the large counts condition check in this setting?

column2: Which set of counts must all be large enough for the interval procedure?

column2: Why does the standard error formula use sample proportions instead of population proportions?

column6: Because the population proportions are only used in randomized experiments.

column2: What does the critical value z* represent in this interval?

column2: If the confidence level increases, what happens to the interval?
